reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: These patches feel cool and refreshing. They are definitely hydrating and brightening. I've tried a few different eye patches, and they didn't really do much in my opinion, so I was a bit skeptical about this one, but it definitely works for my undereye area. Would definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 呢啲眼貼敷上去涼浸浸好舒服。佢哋真係有保濕同提亮效果。我試過幾款唔同嘅眼貼，覺得都冇乜明顯效果，所以對呢款本來有啲保留，但佢對我眼底位置真係 work。一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I didn’t expect much, but these are my favourite now, I almost finished the product before could even write a review. They’re big, stay exactly where you put them, soaked in essence. Small ones are great too, I use them precisely on fine lines. 100% repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我本來冇太大期望，但呢啲而家係我最愛，寫評價之前我已經差不多用晒。眼貼size大，貼完完全唔郁，入面浸滿精华。細size嗰啲都好好用，我會貼喺細紋位置。100% 會再回購。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text:
Using these patches is remarkably simple. After cleansing and drying the face, you apply one patch under each eye and leave them on for about 10 to 15 minutes. The patches adhere well and don’t slide down the face like some others do. That’s a huge plus for anyone who wants to multitask while wearing them. You can easily go about your morning routine or lounge with a book without worrying about readjustment.

The cooling effect is immediate. The gel texture is soothing, and there's a noticeable reduction in puffiness within minutes of application. These patches are designed with a three-layer technology: a gold foil layer to retain heat, an elastic layer to prevent evaporation, and a cellulose fiber to hold the serum. The result is a patch that feels comfortable and secure on the skin while delivering potent hydration.
reviews.zh:
使用呢啲眼貼簡單得出奇。清潔同抹乾塊面之後，每隻眼下面貼一塊，敷大約 10 至 15 分鐘。貼得好穩，唔似其他牌子會滑落塊面。對想敷住同時做其他嘢嘅人嚟講係大加分。你可以輕鬆完成晨間流程，或者歎住睇本書，唔使擔心要重新調位置。

涼感即時有。啫喱質地有舒緩效果，敷完幾分鐘內明顯減淡浮腫。呢啲眼貼採用三層技術：金箔層鎖住熱力，彈性層防止蒸發，纖維素纖維承托精華。結果係塊眼貼貼住皮膚感覺舒適又穩陣，同時提供強效保濕。

愛上咗呢個產品，皮膚感覺非常保濕又清新。我一星期用 3 次，眼底即時感覺平滑咗。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: These are lovely, brightening, non irritating, and seem to depuff really well. I really like how large the under eye pieces are. I do feel like my under eye is brighter after using these in the mornings for about a week now. Will be ordering again for sure.
reviews.zh: 呢啲好正，有提亮效果，唔刺激，而且去浮腫真係好有效。我好鍾意眼底貼嘅尺寸夠大。喺朝早用咗差唔多一個星期之後，我真係感覺到眼底位置亮咗。一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: So I chilled these before using, which felt fantastic in general. The product on the patches soaked in nicely, and didn't leave too much left on the skin when I took them off. No pungent smells. Also, they cover a fairly large area, which helped them stay in place. 10 out of 10 will use again
reviews.zh: 我用之前雪凍咗，總體嚟講感覺超正。眼貼上嘅精華吸收得好好，撕落嚟嘅時候皮膚上冇剩太多。冇刺鼻氣味。加上覆蓋範圍都幾大，幫助佢哋貼穩喺度。10 分滿分，一定會再用。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I used a jar and then bought another one but I noticed something happening when I used the second jar. After I use the patches, tap in the extra product and apply my other skin care this pilling happens. little goop balls that freaked me out. Is it the product or did I not exfoliate but I noticed this happened even after my skin was properly prepped. I feel like I wasted my money.
reviews.zh: 我用完一罐之後再買咗一罐，但用第二罐嘅時候我留意到有嘢發生。用完眼貼之後，拍入剩餘嘅精華再塗其他護膚品，就出現搓泥——細細粒嘅膠粒狀結塊，嚇親我。唔知係產品問題定係我冇去角質，但我留意到即使皮膚有好好打底都會出現。覺得好似嘥咗錢。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Extra Illuminating Eye Gel Patch (Vitamin C) 60 Patches
reviews.text: These are definitely the best kind of eye patches that I’ve ever used! These leave the skin looking and feeling really hydrated and also makes skin look brighter! The fact that these made my under eye skin look so much brighter was almost shocking because nothing has ever done that. I have really dark-reddish under eyes, and after using these once I saw what these were capable of! Definitely recommend and will be using and buying these more!
reviews.zh: 呢啲絕對係我用過最好嘅眼貼！用完之後皮膚望落同摸落都真係好保濕，而且令皮膚望落更亮！呢啲竟然令到我眼底皮膚望落咁光亮，幾乎令人震驚，因為從來冇嘢做到過。我眼底好深色、偏紅，用咗一次之後我已經見到佢嘅威力！一定會推薦，亦會繼續用同回購更多！
